units.source_text: 古歌：“可恨池中萍，越恨越繁荣。

en.t: An old poem says: "How hateful is the duckweed in the pond; the more one resents it, the more luxuriantly it grows.

units.source_text: 犹似恨伊人，越恨越情浓。”

en.t: It is like resenting that person: the more one resents them, the stronger one's feelings become."
See Annotated Translation of The Tale of Genji.
